connector.name: Coal - Payments for AI agents
connector.registryDescription: Payment rails for AI agents. Pay merchants in USDC on Base. Dual-protocol: x402 + OKX APP.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.usecoal.xyz over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the emmanuel39hanks account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Coal-Agent-Key
headers.description: Wallet private key (0x... 64-char hex). Signs payments via EIP-3009 on Base. Optional — read-only tools work without it.

headers.name: X-Coal-Api-Key
headers.description: Coal API key for create_checkout + query_merchant_memory. Get one at https://usecoal.xyz/console/keys. Optional.
